_readme: EMC x TSC1/TSC2 probe, ROUND 3, 2026-08-24 -- the drug-side and trial-side primary records, so that nothing quoted about nab-sirolimus rests on a search summary. Two reasons this round exists. (1) An ERRATUM to the primary AMPECT paper exists (PMID 37890128, J Clin Oncol 2023;41(35), doi 10.1200/jco.23.02173) and its abstract is null, so what it corrected cannot be read from the record -- and the biomarker figure this whole route leans on (8 of 9 TSC2-mutant responders) comes from that paper. The full text is fetched to read the biomarker table verbatim and to see whether a correction notice attaches to it. (2) Round 1 found that PRECISION 1 is closed to accrual but that several OTHER routes are open, including TAPUR, CAPTUR and a French molecular-triage trial with everolimus arms; whether any of them actually matches TSC1/TSC2 to an mTOR inhibitor is a question only the full protocol record answers, and the round-1 rows were fetched with a restricted field list that omitted arms and eligibility.
